source_checks.topic: One metadata query and failure cleanup
observations: One Popen site uses exact selected3.12 -B-I-S -cQUERY and fixed thread-one environment. QUERY imports only json/os/sys and reports executable/version/startup metadata; its literal source/hash matches held plan.

start_new_session=False keeps query in the externally owned helper group; no detached-session birth/handoff is introduced. Helper cleanup signals only its own unreaped direct Popen child, then waits; errors are retained and never treated as absence.

Regular output files avoid pipe-drain deadlock. A successful query requires childRC0, waited/reaped, no error/actions, elapsed-through-cleanup<=5s, complete small single JSON stdout line and empty stderr. Invalid flags/routes/version, timeout, nonzero or failed cleanup refuse.

On failure with an unreaped query, stream hashes are incomplete snapshots despite retained raw files; reaped/error flags prevent positive acceptance. External root must finish group cleanup and take a complete final file census before reporting any failure closure.

The helper does not itself establish group absence. External root must own/verify the helper session, clean the inherited group on abnormal helper loss, wait/reap, retain unknowns/EPERM and independently prove group absence.
